scope: AGENT_EVALUATED_ONLY. Criterion-level partial observations from the owned local source/trace example, not full toolkit, human, shared or production certification.

criterionRatings.name: typography
criterionRatings.deductionOrMissingEvidence: The status words are now intact, but core receipt metadata is10–12px (ticks10.5px) and the default phone proof requires reading dense small text. Enlarging text is a usable workaround; normal-size typography remains below the portfolio target.
criterionRatings.scope: Rendered typography in the fixed-width example only; no human acuity or assistive-technology inference.

criterionRatings.name: spacing/grid
criterionRatings.deductionOrMissingEvidence: The receipt, invoice and provenance groups have consistent padding and clear boundaries. The fixed340px inspector leaves substantial unused width at tablet/desktop, an intentional demo frame with minor spatial inefficiency.
criterionRatings.scope: Observed light-theme composition; no universal layout certification.

criterionRatings.name: color/token discipline
criterionRatings.deductionOrMissingEvidence: Terracotta ownership, indigo agent and green/red/amber state colors remain consistent. Historical dark/light switching was observed; color declarations are unchanged. Corrected dark receipt pixels were not replayed.
criterionRatings.scope: Token/color discipline only; numerical contrast is NOT_RUN.

criterionRatings.name: hierarchy
criterionRatings.deductionOrMissingEvidence: Desktop clearly separates explanation and inspector. At390×844 the first viewport is almost entirely explanatory prose and the card only starts at the bottom, hiding every demo control until scrolling.
criterionRatings.scope: Actual first-view hierarchy; no fresh-human comprehension rating.

criterionRatings.name: rendered legibility/contrast
criterionRatings.deductionOrMissingEvidence: The repaired labels and failure reasons are legible without horizontal loss in the selected normal/enlarged images. Long identifiers use deliberate shortening plus full-copy values. Contrast ratios and WCAG thresholds were not measured.
criterionRatings.scope: Partial rendered-legibility observation only; this score is not a contrast grade.

criterionRatings.name: consistent elevation/icons
criterionRatings.deductionOrMissingEvidence: All42 intended status icons are visibly11×11px; whole chips wrap correctly. Seal elevation and warning icons distinguish outcomes. The fixed11px ticks remain visually small beside doubled21px labels.
criterionRatings.scope: Scoped actual icon/elevation evidence; full-theme icon fidelity is incomplete.

criterionRatings.name: alignment
criterionRatings.deductionOrMissingEvidence: Invoice values, receipt blocks and copy controls stay aligned and contained. Provenance value starts differ with per-row key lengths; the modest variation remains readable rather than an overlap.
criterionRatings.scope: Observed receipt/provenance alignment at the declared cells.

criterionRatings.name: polish of empty/loading/error/populated states
criterionRatings.deductionOrMissingEvidence: Populated, provisional, failed, running and empty fixtures present distinct labels and shapes. Empty/running states retain the prior observed rendering through unchanged owners; they are examples, not executed job lifecycles.
criterionRatings.scope: Static fixture-state polish; no backend lifecycle or production-state coverage.

criterionRatings.name: purposeful motion and reduced-motion behavior
criterionRatings.deductionOrMissingEvidence: Reduced-motion mode and disabled skeleton animation were observed, but no purpose/motion reference or video-based animation evaluation was completed.
criterionRatings.scope: Purposeful motion remains ungraded; no numerical motion score from a still image or CSS count.

criterionRatings.name: Clarity of the main action
criterionRatings.deductionOrMissingEvidence: The instruction to switch traces is explicit, and controls work once reached. On the phone, the instruction and extended explanation precede the actual controls by more than the initial viewport.
criterionRatings.scope: Agent-observed action discovery with a scrolling workaround.

criterionRatings.name: navigation/information architecture
criterionRatings.deductionOrMissingEvidence: Run A–E and Human/Pro/Tech provide a small understandable local navigation model. Content/Sources are surrounding mockup context, not exercised application routes.
criterionRatings.scope: Local trace-example information architecture; real application navigation untested.

criterionRatings.name: progressive disclosure
criterionRatings.deductionOrMissingEvidence: Human/Pro/Tech successfully reveal additional provenance, but the large introductory explanation itself is always expanded ahead of the phone inspector. The first inspection requires scrolling through that explanation.
criterionRatings.scope: Scoped information disclosure in the example; no implied redesign of the toolkit.

criterionRatings.name: useful information density
criterionRatings.deductionOrMissingEvidence: The introduction repeats custody/seal concepts before the first action, and the340px panel packs many small labels into one column. Enlarged text is contained but substantially taller.
criterionRatings.scope: Observed density/friction; no participant task-time or attention measurement.

criterionRatings.name: consistency of component behavior and wording
criterionRatings.deductionOrMissingEvidence: Trace, depth, receipt and copy controls preserve consistent local state and outcome wording. Detailed clipboard recovery is carried in title/accessible feedback rather than persistent inline prose. README identifies the historic live-run language as illustrative fixtures.
criterionRatings.scope: Example controls and documentation only.

criterionRatings.name: Reflow/content preservation
criterionRatings.deductionOrMissingEvidence: All 28 final views (18 receipt states and 10 footer views) preserve horizontal containment and exact protected text/full values across seven normal pairs plus three doubled conditions. Long identifiers and whole status items reflow within the inspector.
criterionRatings.scope: Current affected-layout evidence plus preserved broad controls; no unsupported device/locale extrapolation.

criterionRatings.name: reachability of navigation and primary actions
criterionRatings.deductionOrMissingEvidence: The final Run control is reachable at320 after the wrapping repair; native pointer/keyboard paths were observed. Phone users must scroll to the inspector on first view.
criterionRatings.scope: CSS viewport and actual keyboard/pointer only; real-touch/OS keyboard NOT_RUN.

criterionRatings.name: modal/panel/table/canvas adaptation
criterionRatings.deductionOrMissingEvidence: The inspector, invoice, receipt and provenance adapt without horizontal clipping. Extra scrolling at doubled text is preserved; full-screen adaptation of a real deck editor is not part of this example.
criterionRatings.scope: Owned example panel/table only; no invented modal or canvas test.

criterionRatings.name: touch and on-screen-keyboard usability
criterionRatings.deductionOrMissingEvidence: No physical touch device or on-screen keyboard was used. Chromium viewport dimensions and pointer clicks do not establish finger or OS-keyboard usability.
criterionRatings.scope: Real device evidence required.

criterionRatings.name: stability under zoom, long content and declared locales
criterionRatings.deductionOrMissingEvidence: Computed2× text and320 CSS width were tested, but native200/400% browser zoom, locale promises and additional locale/long-content combinations were not.
criterionRatings.scope: Keep composite zoom/locale criterion ungraded despite bounded reflow observations.

criterionRatings.name: Working controls and keyboard paths
criterionRatings.deductionOrMissingEvidence: Two native390/1440 journeys exercised all five traces, three depth levels,18 row open/close actions per journey, focus retention, both themes and12 transition pairs. Actual copy/retry and repeated copies completed.
criterionRatings.scope: Only the named local example controls; new CSS proof does not claim new native playback.

criterionRatings.name: immediate honest feedback and durable status
criterionRatings.deductionOrMissingEvidence: Clipboard success follows real fulfillment, rejection stays a warning and running/failed fixtures avoid invented billed cost or signature. No durable backend status was exercised.
criterionRatings.scope: Observed immediate local feedback; durable status NOT_RUN.

criterionRatings.name: validation/error/retry behavior
criterionRatings.deductionOrMissingEvidence: Actual NotAllowedError, granted retry and subsequent denial preserve truthful warning/recovery semantics. The unavailable case is explicitly simulated. Validation failure explains two causes without offering a false approval path.
criterionRatings.scope: Native clipboard recovery plus fixture validation; provider/network recovery NOT_RUN.

criterionRatings.name: safe cancellation/undo and duplicate-action handling
criterionRatings.deductionOrMissingEvidence: Sixteen actual Copy clicks including12 repeated copies, timer ordering and12 trace/depth pairs per native journey showed no row/control accumulation. No cancel/undo or pending-write cancellation contract was tested.
criterionRatings.scope: Partial bounded duplicate-action observation, not unlimited concurrency or durable-job cancellation.

criterionRatings.name: state continuity through navigation, reload, conflicts and reopening
criterionRatings.deductionOrMissingEvidence: Fresh contexts and local transitions were observed, but back/forward, interrupted reload, persisted session recovery, conflict/reopen and durable state are not established.
criterionRatings.scope: No lifecycle continuity score from static fixture resets.

criterionRatings.name: Semantic names/structure
criterionRatings.deductionOrMissingEvidence: Buttons and expandable rows have names, pressed/expanded states and keyboard ownership; exact full-copy values remain present. This is DOM/behavior evidence, not a complete accessibility-tree or AT audit.
criterionRatings.scope: Observed semantics only.

criterionRatings.name: keyboard/focus order and modal focus return
criterionRatings.deductionOrMissingEvidence: Native Tab/ShiftTab, Enter/Space, row focus after rerender and theme activation worked in two declared viewports. There is no modal focus-return journey in this surface.
criterionRatings.scope: Partial keyboard/focus evidence; screen readers and alternative inputs untested.

criterionRatings.name: contrast/non-color cues
criterionRatings.deductionOrMissingEvidence: Text labels, borders and icons provide non-color cues, but no numeric contrast evaluation or manual contrast/vision protocol was run.
criterionRatings.scope: No contrast grade inferred from apparently readable pixels.

criterionRatings.name: text resize/reflow and target size
criterionRatings.deductionOrMissingEvidence: Actual trace/depth controls measure24px high, copy buttons remain24×24 and computed doubled text reflows. These meet the measured scope; primary44px ergonomic preference, native zoom and real touch remain unverified.
criterionRatings.scope: Partial measured target/text-reflow result, not WCAG conformance.

criterionRatings.name: screen-reader announcements and reduced-motion alternatives. Manual checks accompany automated scans
criterionRatings.deductionOrMissingEvidence: Live-region strings and reduced-motion CSS state were observed, but no screen reader was used and no complete alternative-motion evaluation was recorded.
criterionRatings.scope: No assistive-technology grade from aria text alone.

criterionRatings.name: Initial usable view
criterionRatings.deductionOrMissingEvidence: No initial-usable-view budget, LCP measurement, field window or device segment was frozen/measured. Command wall time is not rendering performance.
criterionRatings.scope: Performance NOT_RUN.

criterionRatings.name: input/scroll responsiveness
criterionRatings.deductionOrMissingEvidence: No input/scroll latency budget or INP measurement was collected. Successful scripted input is functional evidence only.
criterionRatings.scope: Performance NOT_RUN.

criterionRatings.name: layout stability
criterionRatings.deductionOrMissingEvidence: No CLS or layout-shift measurement was collected; settled snapshots cannot quantify transient stability.
criterionRatings.scope: Performance NOT_RUN.

criterionRatings.name: honest long-operation feedback
criterionRatings.deductionOrMissingEvidence: The running display is a static illustrative fixture, not a timed real long operation. No progress-staleness/cancel/timeout budget was exercised.
criterionRatings.scope: Performance/lifecycle feedback NOT_RUN.

criterionRatings.name: behavior with large data and constrained device/network conditions. Record workload and measured budgets separately from reviewer impressions
criterionRatings.deductionOrMissingEvidence: No large-data, constrained-device or network workload/budget was defined or run. The fixed fixtures do not provide load evidence.
criterionRatings.scope: Performance NOT_RUN.

criterionRatings.name: First-time task comprehension
criterionRatings.deductionOrMissingEvidence: No first-time human participant from the intended developer/QA audience was observed with frozen tasks and assistance counts.
criterionRatings.scope: Fresh human usability NOT_RUN.

criterionRatings.name: successful core journey
criterionRatings.deductionOrMissingEvidence: An agent completed source commands and the example journeys. No human core-task completion study or complete toolkit-in-a-new-project workflow was observed.
criterionRatings.scope: Human core journey and full toolkit adoption NOT_RUN.

criterionRatings.name: bounded errors/help/rework
criterionRatings.deductionOrMissingEvidence: The local copy denial/retry loop is bounded and actionable; source commands provide explicit pass/fail, and the failed fixture preserves reasons. Full toolkit user rework was not exercised.
criterionRatings.scope: Agent-observed local errors/help only.

criterionRatings.name: usable export or consumer result
criterionRatings.deductionOrMissingEvidence: The exact exported HTML runs as a consumer surface, and actual native readback yields the full synthetic digest despite visual shortening. No new real-app QA report, provider output or narrated export was produced.
criterionRatings.scope: Local example consumer/result only.

criterionRatings.name: restart/reopen/handoff without hidden knowledge. Fresh-agent operability is separate from observed fresh-human usability
criterionRatings.deductionOrMissingEvidence: Normal no-install source tests/doctor/proof passed and documentation identifies the browser dependency. A fresh developer end-to-end host setup, toolkit restart/handoff and audit-artifact reopening were not observed.
criterionRatings.scope: Do not equate source-only self-check with full fresh-user operability.

criterionRatings.name: Fit to intended user and job
criterionRatings.deductionOrMissingEvidence: The example helps developers inspect consent, provenance, validation and human authority, matching the toolkit’s agentic-QA purpose. Audience fit is agent evaluated, not validated through users.
criterionRatings.scope: Scoped example fit.

criterionRatings.name: coverage of advertised capabilities
criterionRatings.deductionOrMissingEvidence: The toolkit also advertises audit/gate, multi-host, declutter and proof-video workflows. These were not all executed in a fresh downstream application.
criterionRatings.scope: Coverage of all advertised capabilities NOT_RUN.

criterionRatings.name: truthful limits/status
criterionRatings.deductionOrMissingEvidence: Current documentation identifies A–E/costs as illustrative; source-floor receipts have null browser-derived facts. The UI correctly distinguishes provisional/failed/human-pending and real clipboard success/failure. Historic live-GLM prose is fixture context, not current provider proof.
criterionRatings.scope: Observed documentation/local state truth; production accounting not claimed.

criterionRatings.name: permissions and review authority
criterionRatings.deductionOrMissingEvidence: Native clipboard permissions are obeyed, the fallback has no signable candidate and failed validation withholds a countersignature. No backend authorization, real human signature or owner isolation was tested.
criterionRatings.scope: Local permission and illustrative review-authority boundaries only.

criterionRatings.name: source/trace/artifact consistency
criterionRatings.deductionOrMissingEvidence: Raw/canonical source, exact exported inputs, full-copy values, scripts and before/after artifacts are independently bound. All134 current plus468 historical artifacts and source/Git guards close.
criterionRatings.scope: Strong local source/trace/artifact consistency; no production lineage claim.

hardGates.name: All required criterion evidence complete
hardGates.reason: Missing human/device/zoom/contrast/AT/performance/lifecycle and full-toolkit coverage keeps every dimension/overall score null.

hardGates.name: Portfolio numeric target
hardGates.reason: Five observed criteria are3; no means or letter grades calculated.

hardGates.name: Toolkit advisory audit vs portfolio acceptance
hardGates.reason: GATING.md makes prettify-audit exit0 advisory. It was not run here; its exit convention does not waive this portfolio standard.

hardGates.name: Shared integration and production
hardGates.reason: No current shared/deployment inference from local results.

limitations: All criteria are partial or NOT_RUN; no full dimension, mean, letter grade or readiness pass.
No original0–2 B/V rubric was converted to these1–5 observations.
Static model/cost/consent/signature data does not demonstrate provider operation or human approval.
No contrast ratio or accessibility/performance certification from pixels or CSS counts.
Native200/400% zoom, physical devices, AT, other engines, field performance and large-data workloads absent.
No human first-use participant study or complete toolkit-in-downstream-app execution.
Finite clipboard and transition evidence does not prove unlimited concurrency, pending-write cancellation or durable lifecycle.
Historical broad screenshots are distinguished from new28 corrected receipt pixels; no fresh dark receipt capture.
Prior failures and old grades are retained; central portfolio grade file was not edited.
